data.name: Megahorn
data.description: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

data.name: Attack Order
data.description: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target, hitting its Defense. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

data.name: Bug Buzz
data.description: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

data.name: First Impression
data.description: The user instinctively attacks with great power and speed. It only works the first turn the user is in battle.

data.name: Pollen Puff
data.description: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives them a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

data.name: Leech Life
data.description: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

data.name: Lunge
data.description: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

data.name: X-Scissor
data.description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors. Critical hits are more frequent

data.name: Signal Beam
data.description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. This may also confuse the target.

data.name: Skitter Smack
data.description: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: U-turn
data.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

data.name: Steamroller
data.description: The user crushes its target by rolling over the target with its rolled-up body. This may also make the target flinch.

data.name: Bug Bite
data.description: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

data.name: Silver Wind
data.description: The target is attacked with powdery scales blown by the wind. It gets stronger and hits both foes under Silky Terrain

data.name: Fell Stinger
data.description: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user’s Attack stat is boosted drastically.

data.name: Struggle Bug
data.description: The user attacks by struggling against opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Sp. Atk stats.

data.name: Fury Cutter
data.description: The user attacks by slashing the target with scythes, claws, or the like. This move's power doubles each time it hits in succession.

data.name: Pin Missile
data.description: The user attacks by shooting sharp spikes at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

data.name: Twineedle
data.description: The user damages the target by jabbing it with two spikes. This may also poison the target.

data.name: Infestation
data.description: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can’t flee during this time.

data.name: Defend Order
data.description: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, boosting its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

data.name: Heal Order
data.description: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.

data.name: Powder
data.description: The user covers the target in a combustible powder. If the target uses a Fire-type move, the powder explodes and damages the target.

data.name: Quiver Dance
data.description: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user’s Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

data.name: Rage Powder
data.description: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opposing Pokémon aim only at the user.

data.name: Spider Web
data.description: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can’t flee from battle.

data.name: Sticky Web
data.description: The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers the Speed stats of grounded foes switching into battle.

data.name: String Shot
data.description: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stats.

data.name: Tail Glow
data.description: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically raising its Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: Hyperspace Fury
data.description: Unleashes a barrage of multi-arm attacks, skipping protections. This lowers the user's Defense stat.

data.name: Foul Play
data.description: The user turns the foe's power against it. It does more damage the higher the target's Attack stat.

data.name: Fiery Wrath
data.description: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make foes flinch.

data.name: Darkest Lariat
data.description: The user swings both arms and hits the target. This attack ignores the target's stat changes.

data.name: Night Daze
data.description: The user lets loose a pitch-black shock wave at its target. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

data.name: Crunch
data.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

data.name: Dark Pulse
data.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

data.name: False Surrender
data.description: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. Never misses.

data.name: Jaw Lock
data.description: The user grabs the target with its jaws, preventing the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints.

data.name: Throat Chop
data.description: The user attacks the target's throat. The target cannot use sound-based moves for two turns.

data.name: Wicked Blow
data.description: Strikes with a fierce blow through mastery of the Dark style. Always results in a critical hit.

data.name: Lash Out
data.description: The user lashes out to vent its frustration. Power is doubled if its stats dropped this turn.

data.name: Night Slash
data.description: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. Critical hits land more easily.

data.name: Sucker Punch
data.description: The user unexpectedly attacks the target at incredible speed. However, this move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

data.name: Knock Off
data.description: The user slaps down the target's held item, preventing that item from being used in the battle.

data.name: Assurance
data.description: If the target has already taken damage in the same turn, this attack's power is doubled.

data.name: Bite
data.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.

data.name: Brutal Swing
data.description: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

data.name: Feint Attack
data.description: The user draws up to the foe disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. It hits without fail.

data.name: Thief
data.description: The user attacks and steals the foe's held item simultaneously. It can't steal if the user holds an item.

data.name: Snarl
data.description: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the foes' Sp. Atk stat decrease.

data.name: Payback
data.description: If the user moves after the target, this attack's power will be doubled.

data.name: Pursuit
data.description: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a target that is switching out of battle.

data.name: Beat Up
data.description: The user gets all the party Pokémon to attack the foe. The more party Pokémon, the more damage.

data.name: Fling
data.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

data.name: Power Trip
data.description: The user boasts of its strength. Power increases the more the user's stats are raised.

data.name: Punishment
data.description: This attack's power increases the more the target has powered up with stat changes.

data.name: Dark Void
data.description: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that makes them sleep.

data.name: Embargo
data.description: It prevents the target from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

data.name: Fake Tears
data.description: The user feigns crying to fluster the target, harshly lowering its Sp. Def stat.

data.name: Flatter
data.description: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, it also raises the target's Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: Hone Claws
data.description: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

data.name: Memento
data.description: The user faints when using this move. In return, it harshly lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk.

data.name: Nasty Plot
data.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Atk.

data.name: Obstruct
data.description: The user protects itself from all attacks. Direct contact lowers the attacker's Defense.

data.name: Parting Shot
data.description: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches out.

data.name: Quash
data.description: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

data.name: Snatch
data.description: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat-changing move the foe attempts to use.

data.name: Switcheroo
data.description: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.

data.name: Taunt
data.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

data.name: Topsy-Turvy
data.description: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.

data.name: Torment
data.description: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

data.name: Eternabeam
data.description: This is Eternatus's most powerful attack in its original form. The user can't move on the next turn.

data.name: Dragon Energy
data.description: Converts the user's life-force into power to attack. The higher the user's HP, the higher the move's power.

data.name: Roar of Time
data.description: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.

data.name: Draco Meteor
data.description: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: Outrage
data.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

data.name: Clanging Scales
data.description: The user rubs its scales and makes a huge noise. Also lowers the user's Defense stat.

data.name: Core Enforcer
data.description: If the target has already moved this turn, the effect of its Ability is negated.

data.name: Dragon Rush
data.description: The user recklessly tackles the foe while exhibiting overwhelming menace. The user takes some recoil, but it may also make the target flinch.

data.name: Dynamax Cannon
data.description: The user unleashes a strong beam from its core.

data.name: Spacial Rend
data.description: The user tears the target along with the space around it. Critical hits land more easily.

data.name: Dragon Hammer
data.description: The user uses its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.

data.name: Dragon Pulse
data.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

data.name: Dragon Claw
data.description: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.

data.name: Breaking Swipe
data.description: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks all foes. This also lowers their Attack stats.

data.name: Dragon Breath
data.description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

data.name: Dragon Tail
data.description: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

data.name: Dragon Darts
data.description: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two targets, this move hits each one once.

data.name: Dual Chop
data.description: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

data.name: Twister
data.description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the opposing team. It may also make targets flinch.

data.name: Scale Shot
data.description: Attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. Boosts the user's Speed but lowers its Defense.

data.name: Dragon Rage
data.description: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

data.name: Clangorous Soul
data.description: The user raises all its stats by using some of its HP.

data.name: Dragon Dance
data.description: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

data.name: Bolt Strike
data.description: The user charges at its foe, surrounding itself with lightning. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

data.name: Volt Tackle
data.description: The user electrifies itself, then charges at the foe. It causes considerable damage to the user as well.

data.name: Zap Cannon
data.description: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

data.name: Aura Wheel
data.description: Morpeko attacks and raises its Speed with energy stored in its cheeks. Type changes with the user's form.

data.name: Thunder
data.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

data.name: Fusion Bolt
data.description: The user throws down a giant thunderbolt. It does more damage if influenced by an enormous flame.

data.name: Plasma Fists
data.description: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. Normal-type moves become Electric-type.

data.name: Thunderbolt
data.description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

data.name: Wild Charge
data.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its foe. It also damages the user a little.

data.name: Bolt Beak
data.description: Stabs the target with an electrified beak. Power is doubled if the user attacks first.

data.name: Discharge
data.description: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike the area around the user. It may also cause paralysis.

data.name: Overdrive
data.description: The user attacks all foes by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

data.name: Thunder Cage
data.description: The user traps the target in a cage of sparking electricity for four to five turns.

data.name: Zing Zap
data.description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also make the target flinch.

data.name: Thunder Punch
data.description: The target is punched with an electrified fist. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

data.name: Rising Voltage
data.description: The user attacks with electric voltage rising from the ground. Power is doubled on Electric Terrain.

data.name: Volt Switch
data.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

data.name: Parabolic Charge
data.description: The user attacks everything around it. The user's HP is restored by half the damage dealt.

data.name: Spark
data.description: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

data.name: Thunder Fang
data.description: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

data.name: Shock Wave
data.description: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

data.name: Electroweb
data.description: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.

data.name: Charge Beam
data.description: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user's Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: Thunder Shock
data.description: A jolt of electricity is hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

data.name: Nuzzle
data.description: The user nuzzles its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

data.name: Electro Ball
data.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the foe. It does more damage the faster the user is.

data.name: Charge
data.description: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses next. It also raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

data.name: Eerie Impulse
data.description: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: Electric Terrain
data.description: The user electrifies the ground for five turns. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.

data.name: Electrify
data.description: If the target uses a move after being electrified, that move becomes Electric-type.

data.name: Ion Deluge
data.description: The user disperses electrically charged particles. Normal-type moves become Electric-type.

data.name: Magnet Rise
data.description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

data.name: Magnetic Flux
data.description: Manipulates magnetic fields to raise the Defense and Sp. Def stats of allies with Plus or Minus Abilities.

data.name: Thunder Wave
data.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the target. It causes paralysis if it hits.

data.name: Light of Ruin
data.description: Fires a powerful beam of light drawn from the Eternal Flower. It also damages the user a lot.

data.name: Fleur Cannon
data.description: The user unleashes a strong beam. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: Misty Explosion
data.description: The user unleashes an explosion of mist that hits everyone, at massive damage to itself. Power increases on Misty Terrain.

data.name: Moonblast
data.description: The user attacks by borrowing the power of the moon. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: Play Rough
data.description: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

data.name: Strange Steam
data.description: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.

data.name: Dazzling Gleam
data.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

data.name: Spirit Break
data.description: The user attacks the target with immense force. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: Draining Kiss
data.description: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half of the damage dealt.

data.name: Disarming Voice
data.description: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to foes. This attack never misses.

data.name: Fairy Wind
data.description: The user stirs up a fairy wind and strikes the target with it.

data.name: Nature's Madness
data.description: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target's HP.

data.name: Aromatic Mist
data.description: The user raises the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.

data.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
data.description: The user stares with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. Always goes first.

data.name: Charm
data.description: The user charmingly gazes at the foe, making it less wary. The target's Attack is harshly lowered.

data.name: Crafty Shield
data.description: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power.

data.name: Decorate
data.description: The user sharply raises the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.

data.name: Fairy Lock
data.description: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.

data.name: Floral Healing
data.description: The user restores the target's HP by up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP when the terrain is grass.

data.name: Flower Shield
data.description: The user raises the Defense stats of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.

data.name: Geomancy
data.description: The user absorbs energy and sharply raises its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats on the next turn.

data.name: Misty Terrain
data.description: The user covers the ground with mist for five turns. Grounded Pokémon can't gain status conditions.

data.name: Moonlight
data.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

data.name: Sweet Kiss
data.description: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

data.name: Focus Punch
data.description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.

data.name: Meteor Assault
data.description: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. This move can’t be used twice in a row.

data.name: High Jump Kick
data.description: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.

data.name: Close Combat
data.description: The user fights the foe up close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user's Defense and Sp. Def.

data.name: Focus Blast
data.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

data.name: Superpower
data.description: The user attacks the target with great power. However, it also lowers the user's Attack and Defense.

data.name: Cross Chop
data.description: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. Critical hits land more easily.

data.name: Dynamic Punch
data.description: The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. It confuses the target if it hits.

data.name: Flying Press
data.description: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously.

data.name: Hammer Arm
data.description: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user's Speed, however.

data.name: Jump Kick
data.description: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.

data.name: Sacred Sword
data.description: The user attacks by slicing with its long horns. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage.

data.name: Thunderous Kick
data.description: Overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement, then kicks. Lowers the target's Defense stat.

data.name: Secret Sword
data.description: The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power contained in it does physical damage to the foe.

data.name: Sky Uppercut
data.description: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.

data.name: Aura Sphere
data.description: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.

data.name: Body Press
data.description: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. Power increases the higher the user's Defense is.

data.name: Submission
data.description: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. It also hurts the user slightly.

data.name: Brick Break
data.description: The user attacks with a swift chop, breaking any barrier such as Reflect, dealing extra damage if it does.

data.name: Drain Punch
data.description: An energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

data.name: Vital Throw
data.description: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move is guaranteed not to miss.

data.name: Wake-Up Slap
data.description: This attack inflicts big damage on a sleeping target. It also wakes the target up, however.

data.name: Low Sweep
data.description: The user attacks the target's legs swiftly, reducing the target's Speed stat.

data.name: Circle Throw
data.description: The user throws the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

data.name: Force Palm
data.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

data.name: Revenge
data.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

data.name: Rolling Kick
data.description: The user lashes out with a quick, spinning kick. It may also make the target flinch.

data.name: Storm Throw
data.description: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.

data.name: Karate Chop
data.description: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. Critical hits land more easily.

data.name: Mach Punch
data.description: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.

data.name: Power-Up Punch
data.description: Striking opponents repeatedly makes the user's fists harder, raising the user's Attack stat.

data.name: Rock Smash
data.description: The user attacks with a punch that can shatter a rock. It may also lower the foe's Defense stat.

data.name: Vacuum Wave
data.description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

data.name: Double Kick
data.description: The target is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.

data.name: Arm Thrust
data.description: The user looses a flurry of open-palmed arm thrusts that hit two to five times in a row.

data.name: Triple Kick
data.description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.

data.name: Counter
data.description: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

data.name: Final Gambit
data.description: The user risks all to attack the foe. The user faints but does damage equal to its HP.

data.name: Low Kick
data.description: A powerful low kick that makes the foe fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier foes.

data.name: Reversal
data.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

data.name: Seismic Toss
data.description: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

data.name: Bulk Up
data.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

data.name: Coaching
data.description: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

data.name: Detect
data.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Increases the user's accuracy by 1. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

data.name: Mat Block
data.description: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves.

data.name: No Retreat
data.description: This move raises all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.

data.name: Octolock
data.description: Locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. Also lowers the target's Defense and Sp. Def each turn.

data.name: Quick Guard
data.description: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves. If may fail if used in succession.

data.name: V-create
data.description: With a fiery forehead, the user hurls itself at the foe. It lowers the user's Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed.

data.name: Blast Burn
data.description: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. This move can’t be used twice in a row.

data.name: Eruption
data.description: The user attacks in an explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the less powerful this attack becomes.

data.name: Mind Blown
data.description: The user attacks everything by causing its own head to explode. This also damages the user.

data.name: Shell Trap
data.description: The user sets a shell trap. If it is hit by a physical move, the trap explodes and hurt the attacker.

data.name: Blue Flare
data.description: The user attacks by engulfing the foe in a beautiful, yet intense, blue flame. It may also burn the foe.

data.name: Burn Up
data.description: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. The user will no longer be Fire type.

data.name: Overheat
data.description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil sharply reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: Flare Blitz
data.description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe. The user also takes damage and may burn the target.

data.name: Pyro Ball
data.description: Attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball. May also burn the target.

data.name: Fire Blast
data.description: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

data.name: Fusion Flare
data.description: The user brings down a giant flame. It does more damage if influenced by an enormous thunderbolt.

data.name: Inferno
data.description: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. It leaves the target with a burn.

data.name: Magma Storm
data.description: The target becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for four to five turns.

data.name: Sacred Fire
data.description: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. It may also leave the target with a burn.

data.name: Searing Shot
data.description: An inferno of scarlet flames torches everything around the user. It may leave the foe with a burn.

data.name: Heat Wave
data.description: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on the opposing team. It may also leave targets with a burn.

data.name: Flamethrower
data.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

data.name: Blaze Kick
data.description: The user launches a kick with a high critical-hit ratio. It may also leave the target with a burn.

data.name: Fiery Dance
data.description: Cloaked in flames, the user dances and flaps its wings. It may also raise the user's Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: Fire Lash
data.description: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

data.name: Fire Pledge
data.description: A column of fire hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its Grass equivalent, it makes a sea of fire.

data.name: Lava Plume
data.description: An inferno of scarlet flames torches everything around the user. It may leave targets with a burn.

data.name: Fire Punch
data.description: The target is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the target with a burn.

data.name: Mystical Fire
data.description: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: Burning Jealousy

data.name: Crush Grip
data.description: The target is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the target has left.

data.name: Endeavor
data.description: An attack move that cuts down the target's HP to equal the user's HP.

data.name: Flail
data.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

data.name: Frustration
data.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

data.name: Guillotine
data.description: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target will faint instantly if this attack hits.

data.name: Horn Drill
data.description: The user stabs the foe with a horn that rotates like a drill. If it hits, the target faints instantly.

data.name: Natural Gift
data.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

data.name: Present
data.description: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. If the target is an ally, it restores its HP instead.

data.name: Return
data.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

data.name: Sonic Boom
data.description: A loud, sudden shockwave hits the foes and deals damage.

data.name: Spit Up
data.description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released all at once in an attack.

data.name: Super Fang
data.description: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the target's HP to half.

data.name: Trump Card
data.description: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its attack power.

data.name: Wring Out
data.description: The user powerfully wrings the foe. The more HP the foe has, the greater this attack's power.

data.name: Acupressure
data.description: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.

data.name: After You
data.description: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

data.name: Assist
data.description: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by other Pokémon in the party.

data.name: Attract
data.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

data.name: Baton Pass
data.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.

data.name: Belly Drum
data.description: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.

data.name: Bestow
data.description: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn't holding an item.

data.name: Block
data.description: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

data.name: Camouflage
data.description: The user's type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water's edge, in grass, or in a cave.

data.name: Captivate
data.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target is charmed into harshly lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: Celebrate
data.description: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!

data.name: Confide
data.description: The user tells the target a secret. The target loses focus and its Sp. Atk stat is lowered.

data.name: Conversion
data.description: The user changes its type to become the same type as one of its moves.

data.name: Conversion 2
data.description: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack the opponent used last.

data.name: Copycat
data.description: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

data.name: Court Change
data.description: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.

data.name: Defense Curl
data.description: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

data.name: Disable
data.description: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.

data.name: Double Team
data.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

data.name: Encore
data.description: The user compels the target to keep using only the move it last used for three turns.

data.name: Endure
data.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

data.name: Entrainment
data.description: The user dances to compel the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.

data.name: Flash
data.description: The user flashes a blinding light at the opponents. It can also lower accuracy.

data.name: Focus Energy
data.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

data.name: Follow Me
data.description: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.

data.name: Foresight
data.description: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any kind of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

data.name: Glare
data.description: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

data.name: Growl
data.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making the foe less wary. The foe's Attack stat is lowered.

data.name: Growth
data.description: The user's body grows all at once, raising the Atk and Sp. Atk stats.

data.name: Happy Hour
data.description: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.

data.name: Harden
data.description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

data.name: Heal Bell
data.description: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all the party Pokémon.

data.name: Helping Hand
data.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of its attack.

data.name: Hold Hands
data.description: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.

data.name: Howl
data.description: The user howls loudly to raise the spirit of itself and allies, boosting their Attack stats.

data.name: Laser Focus
data.description: The user focuses intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.

data.name: Leer
data.description: The user gains an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The target's Defense stat is reduced.

data.name: Lock-On
data.description: The user takes sure aim at the target. It ensures the next attack does not fail to hit the target.

data.name: Lovely Kiss
data.description: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it suceeds, the target falls asleep.

data.name: Lucky Chant
data.description: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing the foe from landing critical hits.

data.name: Me First
data.description: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe's intended move with greater power.

data.name: Mean Look
data.description: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

data.name: Metronome
data.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

data.name: Milk Drink
data.description: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

data.name: Mimic
data.description: The user copies the move last used by the foe. The move can be used until the user is switched out.

data.name: Mind Reader
data.description: The user senses the foe's movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the foe.

data.name: Minimize
data.description: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.

data.name: Morning Sun
data.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

data.name: Nature Power
data.description: An attack that makes use of nature's power. Its effects vary depending on the user's environment.

data.name: Noble Roar
data.description: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers its Attack and Sp. Atk.

data.name: Odor Sleuth
data.description: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

data.name: Pain Split
data.description: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.

data.name: Perish Song
data.description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

data.name: Play Nice
data.description: The user and target become friends. The target loses its will to fight, lowering its Attack stat.

data.name: Protect
data.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

data.name: Psych Up
data.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

data.name: Recover
data.description: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.

data.name: Recycle
data.description: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

data.name: Reflect Type
data.description: The user reflects the target's type, making it the same type as the target.

data.name: Refresh
data.description: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.

data.name: Roar
data.description: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

data.name: Safeguard
data.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

data.name: Scary Face
data.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.

data.name: Screech
data.description: An earsplitting screech harshly reduces the target's Defense stat.

data.name: Sharpen
data.description: The user sharpens their body on a grindstone to become more deadly, raising their Attack and accuracy.

data.name: Shell Smash
data.description: The user breaks its shell, lowering its defenses but sharply raising attacking and Speed stats.

data.name: Simple Beam
data.description: The user's mysterious psychic wave changes the target's Ability to Simple.

data.name: Sing
data.description: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the target into a deep slumber.

data.name: Sketch
data.description: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the foe. Once used, Sketch disappears.

data.name: Slack Off
data.description: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP.

data.name: Sleep Talk
data.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

data.name: Smokescreen
data.description: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the target's accuracy.

data.name: Soft-Boiled
data.description: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

data.name: Splash
data.description: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

data.name: Spotlight
data.description: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only it will be attacked during the turn.

data.name: Stockpile
data.description: The user charges power and increases Defense, sp. Def and weight. The move can be used three times.

data.name: Stuff Cheeks
data.description: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply raises its Defense stat.

data.name: Substitute
data.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user's decoy.

data.name: Supersonic
data.description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

data.name: Swagger
data.description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, it also sharply raises the target's Attack stat.

data.name: Swallow
data.description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP.

data.name: Sweet Scent
data.description: A sweet scent that lowers the foe's evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon if used in grass, etc.

data.name: Swords Dance
data.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user's Attack stat.

data.name: Tail Whip
data.description: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stat.

data.name: Tearful Look
data.description: Gets teary eyed to make the target lose its will to fight. Lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk.

data.name: Teatime
data.description: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

data.name: Teeter Dance
data.description: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.

data.name: Tickle
data.description: The user tickles the target into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.

data.name: Transform
data.description: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.

data.name: Whirlwind
data.description: The foe is blown away, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

data.name: Wish
data.description: One turn after this move is used, the target's HP is restored by half the user's maximum HP.

data.name: Work Up
data.description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

data.name: Yawn
data.description: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

data.name: Belch
data.description: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.

data.name: Gunk Shot
data.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. It may also poison the target.

data.name: Sludge Wave
data.description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.

data.name: Shell Side Arm
data.description: Inflicts physical or special damage, whichever will be more effective. May also poison the target.

data.name: Sludge Bomb
data.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

data.name: Poison Jab
data.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle or arm seeped with poison. It may also poison the target.

data.name: Cross Poison
data.description: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the foe. Critical hits land more easily.

data.name: Sludge
data.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

data.name: Venoshock
data.description: The user drenches the foe in a special poisonous liquid. Its power doubles if the target is affected by a status problem.

data.name: Clear Smog
data.description: The user attacks by throwing a clump of special mud. All status changes are returned to normal.

data.name: Poison Fang
data.description: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. It may also leave the target badly poisoned.

data.name: Poison Tail
data.description: The user hits the target with its tail. It may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.

data.name: Acid
data.description: The foe is attacked with a spray of harsh acid. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

data.name: Acid Spray
data.description: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def stat.

data.name: Smog
data.description: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.

data.name: Poison Sting
data.description: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

data.name: Acid Armor
data.description: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.

data.name: Baneful Bunker
data.description: Protects the user from attacks. Also poisons any attacker that makes contact with the user.

data.name: Coil
data.description: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

data.name: Corrosive Gas
data.description: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.

data.name: Gastro Acid
data.description: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid negates the effect of the target's Ability.

data.name: Poison Gas
data.description: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon. It may poison those hit.

data.name: Poison Powder
data.description: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust on the target. It may poison the target.

data.name: Purify
data.description: The user heals the target's status condition. If so, it also restores the user's own HP.

data.name: Toxic
data.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

data.name: Toxic Spikes
data.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe's feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.

data.name: Toxic Thread
data.description: The user shoots venom-imbued threads to poison the target and lower the their Speed stat.

data.name: Venom Drench
data.description: Foes are drenched in an odd liquid that lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed of poisoned Pokémon.

data.name: Prismatic Laser
data.description: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.

data.name: Psycho Boost
data.description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: Future Sight
data.description: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

data.name: Synchronoise
data.description: Using an odd shock wave, the user damages any Pokémon of the same type as the user.

data.name: Dream Eater
data.description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user's HP.

data.name: Photon Geyser
data.description: The user attacks with a pillar of light. This move the higher of the user's Attack or Sp. Atk stat.

data.name: Psystrike
data.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

data.name: Freezing Glare
data.description: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.

data.name: Psychic
data.description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the target's Sp. Def stat.

data.name: Psychic Fangs
data.description: The user bites the target using psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect, and it increases its power.

data.name: Eerie Spell
data.description: The user attacks with tremendous psychic power. This also removes 3 PP from the target's last move.

data.name: Expanding Force
data.description: The user attacks the target with psychic power. Powers up and hits all foes on Psychic Terrain.

data.name: Extrasensory
data.description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. It may also make the target flinch.

data.name: Hyperspace Hole
data.description: Using a hyperspace hole, the user appears right next to the target and strikes. Skips protections.

data.name: Psyshock
data.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

data.name: Zen Headbutt
data.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

data.name: Luster Purge
data.description: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. It may also reduce the target's Sp. Def stat.

data.name: Mist Ball
data.description: A mistlike flurry of down envelops and damages the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Atk.

data.name: Psycho Cut
data.description: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.

data.name: Psybeam
data.description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray of light. It may also cause confusion.

data.name: Heart Stamp
data.description: The user unleashes a vicious blow after its cute act makes the foe less wary. It may also cause flinching.

data.name: Confusion
data.description: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the target confused.

data.name: Stored Power
data.description: The user attacks with stored power. The more the user's stats are raised, the greater the damage.

data.name: Mirror Coat
data.description: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

data.name: Psywave
data.description: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.

data.name: Agility
data.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

data.name: Ally Switch
data.description: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.

data.name: Amnesia
data.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

data.name: Barrier
data.description: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

data.name: Calm Mind
data.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

data.name: Cosmic Power
data.description: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

data.name: Gravity
data.description: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.

data.name: Guard Split
data.description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of its target.

data.name: Guard Swap
data.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the target.

data.name: Heal Block
data.description: For five turns, the foe is prevented from using any moves, Abilities, or held items that recover HP.

data.name: Heal Pulse
data.description: The user emits a healing pulse which restores the target's HP by up to half of its max HP.

data.name: Healing Wish
data.description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.

data.name: Heart Swap
data.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.

data.name: Hypnosis
data.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

data.name: Imprison
data.description: If the foe knows any move also known by the user, the foe is prevented from using it.

data.name: Instruct
data.description: The user instructs the target to use the target's last move again.

data.name: Kinesis
data.description: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. It lowers the target's accuracy.

data.name: Light Screen
data.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.

data.name: Lunar Dance
data.description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.

data.name: Magic Coat
data.description: A barrier reflects back to the target moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.

data.name: Magic Powder
data.description: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target to Psychic type.

data.name: Magic Room
data.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.

data.name: Meditate
data.description: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack and Special Attack stat.

data.name: Miracle Eye
data.description: Enables the user to hit a Dark type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

data.name: Power Split
data.description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.

data.name: Power Swap
data.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the target.

data.name: Power Trick
data.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.

data.name: Psychic Terrain
data.description: Protects grounded Pokémon from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

data.name: Psycho Shift
data.description: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.

data.name: Reflect
data.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.

data.name: Rest
data.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user's HP and heals any status problem.

data.name: Role Play
data.description: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target's natural Ability.

data.name: Skill Swap
data.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

data.name: Speed Swap
data.description: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

data.name: Telekinesis
data.description: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

data.name: Teleport
data.description: The user switches place with a party Pokémon. Also warps to the last Pokémon Center visited.

data.name: Trick
data.description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

data.name: Trick Room
data.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

data.name: Wonder Room
data.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for 5 turns.

data.name: Head Smash
data.description: The user attacks the foe with a hazardous, full-power headbutt. The user also takes terrible damage.

data.name: Rock Wrecker
data.description: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.

data.name: Meteor Beam
data.description: Gathers space power and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, attacks on the next turn.

data.name: Diamond Storm
data.description: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage foes. This may also sharply raise the user's Defense stat.

data.name: Stone Edge
data.description: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

data.name: Power Gem
data.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

data.name: Rock Slide
data.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foes to inflict damage. It may also make the targets flinch.

data.name: Ancient Power
data.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user's stats at once.

data.name: Rock Tomb
data.description: Boulders are hurled at the target. It also lowers the target's Speed by preventing its movement.

data.name: Rock Throw
data.description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.

data.name: Smack Down
data.description: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.

data.name: Accelerock
data.description: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

data.name: Rollout
data.description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

data.name: Rock Blast
data.description: The user hurls hard rocks at the target. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.

data.name: Rock Polish
data.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

data.name: Sandstorm
data.description: Summons a five-turn sandstorm to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

data.name: Stealth Rock
data.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

data.name: Tar Shot
data.description: Pours sticky tar over the target, lowering its Speed and making it weaker to Fire-type moves.

data.name: Wide Guard
data.description: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for a turn. May fail if used in succession.

data.name: Doom Desire
data.description: Two turns after this move is used, the user blasts the target with a concentrated bundle of light.

data.name: Steel Beam
data.description: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

data.name: Steel Roller
data.description: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails when the ground isn't a terrain.

data.name: Behemoth Bash
data.description: The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into the target.

data.name: Behemoth Blade
data.description: The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target.

data.name: Iron Tail
data.description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

data.name: Sunsteel Strike
data.description: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. Can't be stopped by the target's Ability.

data.name: Meteor Mash
data.description: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. It may also raise the user's Attack.

data.name: Anchor Shot
data.description: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain. The target becomes unable to flee.

data.name: Flash Cannon
data.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

data.name: Iron Head
data.description: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

data.name: Smart Strike
data.description: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

data.name: Steel Wing
data.description: The target is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user's Defense stat.

data.name: Double Iron Bash
data.description: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes twice. May cause flinching.

data.name: Mirror Shot
data.description: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

data.name: Magnet Bomb
data.description: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack will not miss.

data.name: Gear Grind

data.description: The user creates a wall that weakens Water and Fairy-type moves for five turns, and blocks sound-based moves.

data.name: Magic Wall
data.description: The user creates a wall under misty terrain that weakens moves for five turns.

data.name: Dragon's Blessing
data.description: The user bestows dragon scales to reinforce all Dragon-type Pokémon on the field, increasing Defense. If a Pokémon isn't Dragon-type, it gains that Type.

data.name: Seance Pyre
data.description: The user burns themselves, while burning everybody else.

data.name: Berry Punch
data.description: The user eats their berry before rushing fist-first to eat the target's.

data.name: Wellspring Syphon
data.description: The user syphon water from the opponents' bodies to replenish themself. Restores HP equal to half the damage dealt.

data.name: Rocking On
data.description: The user rocks out with all their passion, rising their Attack, Special Attack and Speed.

data.name: Wild Dance
data.description: A reckless dance that tramples over the opponents. It also deals recoil damage to the user.

data.name: Bremand Rhapsody
data.description: The user attacks with a song. Other Bremand can join in the Raphsody and make the attack do more damage.

data.name: Blue Note
data.description: Opposing Pokémon are hit by a relaxing music that makes them sleep.

data.name: Disco Fever
data.description: The user sings a song that compels both opponents to dance until they feel the heat, leaving them burned.

data.name: Electro Swing
data.description: The user sings an energetic song, that leaves the target paralyzed.

data.name: Color Claw
data.description: The user slices the opponent with its colorful claws. More likely to score a Critical Hit. Type changes with the user's type.

data.name: Perfect Glare
data.description: The user intimidates the target with a fearsome gaze, paralyzing the opponent.
